reviews.t: broke after trying it on for the first time
reviews.x: i bought 2 packs of those claw clips and all 3 broke. idk if its bc i have thick hair and they are small, but even if that was the case, my first attempt to clip my hair (the gray one) it broke immediately. what a waste. but in terms of size of the claw clip, for my thick hair, it was only enough to put up a half up and half down look. if you try to put it in a bun, it’ll just keep falling off.  p.s. i also tried hot gluing and super gluing back together, but it still broke apart :/

Not bad for the price.  Teeth are thinner than expected and it doesn't hold a lot of hair.  I have a lot of fine hair, length is past mid-back. Only good for putting front of my hair up.  Pic with all hair up left a huge ponytail on side of head.  Colors true to Amazon pic.  Was looking for a ticket more durable one to put up all my hair. But they look nice.

These are long, not large. The clips are cute but if you have thick hair like I do, it doesn’t really do the trick if you want it all back. I would say the black one holds more hair since the legs are longer. I haven’t decided if I’ll keep or not.
Stayed in  place without being too tight

they’re so cute! not as big as i thought they were and i have super thick hair so they won’t hold all of my hair up. but they work great for a half up half down look! if you have thinner hair, it should hold all of your hair up
These are so pretty. Unfortunately, both broke.  Garbage.  Do not waste your $.  But the Goody brand.
These are so cute!! Great quality and super fast shipping.

reviews.t: Fits mid long thick hair perfectly & stays in place
reviews.x: These are my go to fix when I don't feel like messing with my hair or don't want a ponytail. They have a great grip for securing my mid long thick hair without straining or pinching the scalp. A quick twist of the hair, clip it and done! It does pull a little taut but that is expected. It fits everything perfectly and stays in place all day through heat, humidity and even rain. I specifically wanted the tortoise shell pattern because they are stylish, look well made and accessorize well with any

When they clips arrived I was cautiously optimistic.  To go back a bit, I am one of thousands with Covid hair....I have been growing it out from a pixie for almost 2 years.  Trouble is,  I am only just learning how to handle this grey, wavy, mop.  I need it out of my face every day.  Looking cute is good every other day too.  These clips help set my hair in the right direction and when that doesn't work,allow me to negotiate a compromise for the day.  Recommend highly.

I like the style of them, but they are much smaller than you’d think based on the photos! My hair is probably about 5” past my shoulders and it barely fits my hair in it. Looks nice and *just barely* fits my hair in it... will need to buy new ones that are larger though...

I should have listened to the reviews. They were too small for my long hair. They were the size you would use if you wanted to only put up the top part of your hair. I had to return because I wanted to use them to twist all of my hair up onto the back of my head.

Put  my  hair  up  in  the claw clip to  do  housework (ugh) and no problems - my hair stayed put  even when  I had to  change the  duvet on my bed (grr ugh!).  I'm happy with my purchase.  These are good for putting all your hair up.

please don't buy this product! the clips are really weak. They both broke the same day that I bough them. my suspicion is that the glue holding them together is just extremely weak. I would look elsewhere for something similar.

Make sure you read the dimensions for these clips! I didn’t and they are much smaller than I thought. They look like large clips in the picture in the girls hair and that’s what I went by. Nice clips but really small.

These clips are a joke, they are the smallest ones I've ever seen and wouldn't hold anyone's hair no matter how thin. They are labeled as "large" but are the furthest things from it. Definitely a scam, do not buy.

reviews.t: Perfect for longish or thick hair
reviews.x: Perfect hair clips for think and longer hair.  They have a solid clamp and stay put with reasonable movement.  These worked for my daughters 13 & 11 but my hair was a too fine to look cute with the clip.
i wish i could give this 0 stars.. one of the broke the day i received them. thought i was unlucky. 2 weeks later, there goes the second one. Poor poor quality, don’t waste your $$$

reviews.t: Not for thick or long hair
reviews.x: The clips are super cute but just a warning if you have really thick or long hair these will not really work for you. I would not suggest buying them if you have this type of hair.

reviews.t: Not the size shown in photos!
reviews.x: The clips in reality are half the size of what is seen here. They work, just not as I had intended. I have very long thick hair and the clips I receieve do not hold all of it.
These are a lot smaller in person. They can hardly hold up all of my hair like shown in the image. However, the patterns are super cute and they feel like awesome quality!

reviews.t: Super cute! Just didn’t hold my long, thick hair up!
reviews.x: Loved the color, they just weren’t big enough to clip my hair. I do have long and thick hair though so I could imagine shorter or thinner hair would hold great with these!

reviews.t: Don’t expect these to be larg
reviews.x: These are not large hair clips!!  They should be labeled small to medium at best.  Won’t hold thick hair, gave to my daughter who has thinner hair and she loves them.
So cheap it immediately broke the first time I squeezed it.  Each side is glued together and not a solid piece of plastic.  Don’t waste your money.  Returning.
I have really thick hair so I had my doubts about these, but they’re able to securely hold all my hair! The perfect size—just big enough but not too big
Overall quality is good, but the item picture is false advertising it makes the clip loo larger than it is and for that reason i gave it 3 stars...

claims.text: Many reviewers find the clips smaller than expected and too small to hold all of their hair, especially for thick or long hair.
Several reviewers report the clips breaking easily, sometimes on first use or within a day.
Some reviewers with thick hair say the clips work well for half-up styles or holding their hair securely in place.
Reviewers frequently describe the clips as cute and good value for the price.
